name: Iran
shortSummary: India's relationship with Iran centres on the strategically vital Chabahar Port, developed to bypass Pakistan for access to Afghanistan and Central Asia, though US sanctions have sharply constrained trade, including a near-total halt in oil imports since 2019.
complexity: India stopped importing Iranian crude oil in 2019 after the US ended sanctions waivers, and negotiations over the Farzad-B gas field have stalled for years, even as Chabahar Port cooperation continues.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Indian-operated port terminal providing access to Afghanistan and Central Asia bypassing Pakistan.
Iran forms a key link in the India-Russia-Central Asia transport corridor.

majorChallenges.title: US sanctions exposure
majorChallenges.description: Sanctions constrain financial transactions, insurance and oil trade with Iran.

majorChallenges.title: Stalled Farzad-B gas field
majorChallenges.description: Negotiations over Indian development of the Farzad-B gas field have remained unresolved for years.

recentDevelopments.title: Ten-year Chabahar Port operating agreement signed
recentDevelopments.description: India signed a long-term agreement to operate the Shahid Beheshti terminal at Chabahar Port for ten years.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Locks in India's access to a strategically important trade and connectivity route to Afghanistan and Central Asia despite broader sanctions constraints on Iran.

historicalEvents.title: Delhi Declaration
historicalEvents.description: India and Iran sign a roadmap for strategic cooperation during President Khatami's visit as Republic Day chief guest.

historicalEvents.title: Chabahar Port Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India signs a trilateral agreement with Iran and Afghanistan to develop Chabahar Port, providing a route to Afghanistan and Central Asia bypassing Pakistan.

historicalEvents.title: Halt of Oil Imports
historicalEvents.description: India ends imports of Iranian crude oil after the United States terminates sanctions waivers.
historicalEvents.impact: Sharply reduced bilateral trade and pushed India toward alternative crude suppliers including the US, Iraq and Russia.

historicalEvents.title: Long-Term Chabahar Port Operating Agreement
historicalEvents.description: India signs a 10-year agreement to operate the Shahid Beheshti terminal at Chabahar Port.

agreements.name: Chabahar Port Long-Term Operating Agreement
agreements.description: Ten-year agreement for India's state-run port operator to run the Shahid Beheshti terminal.

multilateralRelations.detail: Iran is a key transit link in this India-backed multimodal corridor to Russia and Central Asia.
